label: fuse compressed-row expansion with memory addition
hypothesis: Preserve within-call deduplicated CPU lookup/H2D but fuse GPU inverse-index expansion into required k+m, avoiding a full temporary and separate expansion kernel on each layer.
expected_bottleneck: Frozen A0009 b8 profile: 24 expansions, 1.50928 ms summed CUDA stream intervals and 1.55864 ms CPU spans, overlapping. A0009 unfused screen was 2.01742 ms slower than A0001; no claim that all expansion time is removable.
change: Compressed offload consumption only for pipeline inputs >=8192 tokens. Use a fused gather-plus-add handle for folded tables; preserve materializing acquire API and unfolded normalization fallback. No lookup/output caching across calls.
tradeoffs: Additional inverse-index storage remains counted; compressed buffers retain their full capacity.
Indirect GPU loads and Triton dispatch may offset saved materialization; CPU unique cost persists.
Primary target b8 prefill; unchanged b1 and decode paths cannot nominate a gain.
arithmetic_contract: Zero absolute/relative tolerance against folded reference, declared before results. Load BF16 K and selected M, FP32 elementwise addition, cast to K dtype; no reduction/reassociation. Tests must prove exactness before timing; no tolerance relaxation.

ablation.scope: Prior stored screen supplies descriptive unfused comparison on the same source/protocol/environment; do not claim a confirmed fusion-only speedup from it. Retention requires independent parent/frozen-baseline and full gates.

decision: All 48 fixed parent-confirmation jobs complete. Target b8 prefill offload reduction 0.366669 ms CI[-0.645449,1.378787], gap reduction 0.158634 CI[-0.449015,0.766283].
